NexaFlow is a French web and software development business based in Metz. We build custom applications, websites and automation tools, and develop and maintain OpenFamily, an open-source family organizer that you can host on your own server.
This repository provides the OpenFamily Docker template for Unraid. OpenFamily brings together a shared calendar, tasks, shopping lists, meal planning, recipes, pantry tracking and household budgeting, with a web interface and an Android app.
Project and documentation: [OpenFamily](https://github.com/NexaFlowFrance/OpenFamily).
Support and bug reports: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/NexaFlowFrance/OpenFamily/issues).
